Tornado Cash

Tornado Cash is a decentralized cryptocurrency mixer on Ethereum, revolutionizing transaction privacy. Since its 2019 launch, it enables users to deposit ETH or ERC-20 tokens, mix them with zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs), and withdraw to new addresses, ensuring anonymity. The US scraps sanctions on Tornado Cash in March 2025, affirming its role as a non-custodial, DAO-governed protocol using $TORN tokens. Explore its privacy features at tornado.cash .

Tornado Cash delivers unmatched privacy for blockchain transactions, ideal for users prioritizing anonymity. Its decentralized, open-source design ensures user control, while zk-SNARKs guarantee untraceable transfers. With the US scrapping sanctions on Tornado Cash, it’s a trusted choice for secure, private crypto transactions.

🌸 How Does Tornado Cash Work?

Tornado Cash uses Ethereum smart contracts and zero-knowledge proofs to anonymize transactions. Users deposit funds, receive a secret hash, and withdraw to a new address without linking to the original deposit. This cryptographic process, refined since 2019, ensures privacy. The US scraps sanctions on Tornado Cash, reinforcing its legitimacy as an open-source protocol accessible via GitHub for developer contributions.

  • Deposit ETH or ERC-20 tokens into a mixing pool.
  • Secure a secret hash for anonymous withdrawals.
  • Withdraw funds to a new address with zk-SNARKs.

The core mechanism of Tornado Cash remains a gold standard for decentralized privacy, bolstered by the US scrapping sanctions on Tornado Cash, ensuring its continued operation on Ethereum networks.

🎉 Regulatory Milestones

Tornado Cash pioneered blockchain privacy in 2019 but faced scrutiny when the U.S. sanctioned it in 2022 for illicit use. A pivotal November 2024 U.S. Appeals Court ruling declared its smart contracts aren’t "property," leading to the US scrapping sanctions on Tornado Cash by March 2025. This landmark decision cements its role as a privacy leader.
